headline: Deposit interest rates stay high, room to improve NIM is increasingly narrow
summary: Deposit interest rates in Vietnam remain high while lending rates face downward pressure. This makes it hard for banks to improve their net interest margins, although credit growth and non-interest income still support profits.
why: Net interest margin, the gap between lending and deposit rates, is the core earnings driver for commercial banks.
